root_cause: A newly introduced Railway first-deploy workflow referenced secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN without an explicit repository security-policy exception. The every-push gate correctly failed closed before deployment validation or image execution.
containment: Do not merge evidence or provider-recovery changes while main security is red.
Keep repository-wide secret consumption denied by default.
Scope RAILWAY_TOKEN to the single deployment step rather than job-wide environment.
Disable persisted checkout credentials in the deployment workflow.
learning: A deployment credential exception must be encoded as a narrow deterministic policy, never as a general relaxation of secret restrictions. Any second secret, second workflow, target drift, untrusted trigger, mutable runner/action, or credential-persisting checkout must fail closed.
claim_boundary: This mitigation authorizes only the reviewed staging bootstrap path. It is not a general approval for workflow secrets or production deployment.
